verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists an audit log with API access ('Auditability (audit log and API)'), so a first-party audit log with programmatic retrieval exists. An incident responder's account of analyzing TeamViewer connection logs loosely corroborates that connection records are kept. The evidence is a single thin line, though, and never says what the log records or how to export it. Missing for 10: documented fields showing who connected to which device and when, an explicit export format (CSV/report) for auditors, and in-depth first-party docs on the audit log and its API.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
